title: Some ai images I tried to make of the auditorium and train
content: I’ve been to an auditorium like this it’s big white and very bright with big windows and these pictures don’t capture it because ai is hard to do with such simple prompts but it’s so big and there two stages one to the right and one to the left with orchestra instruments on one and white church isle seats I also found a rlly good image of what the red train looks like if you’ve been on that
